description: This file is a shell script designed for testing the output of 'git push --porcelain' commands under various scenarios, including normal push, force push, atomic push, dry-run, and handling pre-receive hook rejections. It creates temporary repositories, sets up upstream and working repositories, performs git push operations, and verifies the outputs against expected values.

methods.name: create_commits_in
methods.description: Creates commits within a specified repository and assigns their commit hashes to variable names provided as arguments.

methods.name: get_abbrev_oid
methods.description: Generates an abbreviated object ID from a full commit SHA, used to anonymize commit IDs in output.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Reformats git command outputs to replace dynamic values like commit IDs with placeholders for stable testing.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Processes the expected output to match formatting conventions for comparison.

methods.name: setup_upstream
methods.description: Sets up a bare upstream git repository, optionally cloning and configuring it.

methods.name: setup_upstream_and_workbench
methods.description: Sets up an upstream repository and a local working clone, configuring branch refs and remote URL for testing.

methods.name: run_git_push_porcelain_output_test
methods.description: Executes a series of 'git push --porcelain' operations under different protocols and options, verifying output and repository states.

methods.name: run_git_push_dry_run_porcelain_output_test
methods.description: Runs 'git push --porcelain --dry-run' tests to verify push previews without modifying repositories.
